title: The Ghost's Hand
teaser: Special Division 4 finished off the Avalanche Devil, but the road was buried, and the squad is spending the night at a temple on the pass. At 01:50 Himeno was found dead in the snow by the hot spring. Her neck bears the marks of a huge hand, exactly like the hand of the Ghost Devil she has a contract with. But the Ghost doesn't touch its master. A single line of footprints leads to the spring, and they're her own. Makima arrives in the morning, and she'll want a name.

habits.label: Horns on the head
habits.habit: A pair of short horns on their head that even a hat can't hide
clues: The low beam in the gallery has two fresh scratches at head height, as if horns caught it. The culprit has horns on their head.
The paper door to the gallery has two little holes at forehead height. The culprit has horns on their head.

habits.label: Bread and jam
habits.habit: Spreads jam on anything edible and carries a jar around
clues: The gallery rail has a sticky smear of strawberry jam. The culprit eats bread and jam.
A jar of jam went missing from the kitchen, and the empty one was found in the snow by the spring fence. The culprit eats bread and jam.

habits.label: Cat hair
habits.habit: Has a cat at home, and all their clothes are covered in its hair
clues: Ginger cat hairs are stuck to a wet stone at the edge of the spring. The culprit has cat hair on their clothes.
The towel at the entrance to the spring has cat hair on it, though the temple keeps no cats. The culprit has cat hair on their clothes.

habits.label: Plaster on the nose
habits.habit: Goes around with a plaster on their nose after every fight
clues: A plaster that came unstuck is floating in the spring. The culprit has a plaster on their nose.
A wrapper from a narrow plaster, the kind stuck on noses, was dropped in the gallery. The culprit has a plaster on their nose.

habits.label: Grenade pin ring
habits.habit: Wears the ring from a grenade pin on their finger as jewellery
clues: A grenade pin ring glints in the snow by the spring gate. The culprit wears a grenade pin ring.
The gallery rail has a row of round dents, as if someone tapped it with a ring for a long time. The culprit wears a grenade pin ring.

habits.label: Had too much sake
habits.habit: Drank more than anyone at the banquet and still hasn't sobered up
clues: A sake cup from the guest hall lies by the spring gate, and Himeno drank only from her own flask. The culprit had too much sake.
The novice saw someone walking along the gallery, holding on to the wall and swaying. The culprit had too much sake.

habits.label: Chain round the neck
habits.habit: Wears a thick iron chain round their neck that clanks with every step
clues: The novice heard a short clank of iron in the gallery, as if a thick chain rattled. The culprit wears a chain round their neck.
A bent link from a thick chain is caught on the spring fence. The culprit wears a chain round their neck.

habits.label: Drinks donor blood
habits.habit: Carries a bag of donor blood and sips from it through a tube
clues: There are drops of blood on the snow by the spring, though Himeno hasn't a single wound. A tube from a donor blood bag lies nearby. The culprit drinks donor blood.
In the temple kitchen rubbish there's an empty donor blood bag stamped by a Tokyo hospital. The culprit drinks donor blood.

habits.label: Sharp teeth
habits.habit: Teeth as sharp as a shark's, which makes their smile unsettling
clues: The cork from a big sake bottle by the spring has marks of shark-sharp teeth. The culprit has sharp teeth.
A chopstick bitten in half by sharp teeth lies by the spring gate. The culprit has sharp teeth.

habits.label: Missing little finger
habits.habit: Gave their little finger to a devil under contract and hides the hand in their sleeve
clues: The frost on the gallery rail has a handprint without a little finger. The culprit is missing a little finger.
The misted mirror under the awning by the spring has a handprint with four fingers. The culprit is missing a little finger.

habits.label: Peels tangerines
habits.habit: Never leaves the kotatsu and peels tangerine after tangerine
clues: Tangerine peel taken off in a single spiral lies at the entrance to the spring. The culprit peels tangerines.
The latch on the spring gate is sticky and smells of tangerine. The culprit peels tangerines.

habits.label: Face mask
habits.habit: Afraid of catching cold and never takes off a gauze mask
clues: A gauze mask with a torn tie lies in the snow by the spring gate. The culprit wears a face mask.
The abbot saw a figure in the gallery with half its face covered by something white. The culprit wears a face mask.

habits.label: Smells of cologne
habits.habit: Splashes on cheap cologne, and the smell trails down the whole corridor
clues: A sharp smell of cheap cologne hung by the spring gate until morning. The culprit smells of cologne.
A towel under the awning by the spring has a patch that reeks of cologne. The culprit smells of cologne.

habits.label: Smells of petrol
habits.habit: Their hands and clothes always smell of petrol
clues: The spring gate handle smells sharply of petrol. The culprit smells of petrol.
There's a little rainbow patch of petrol on the snow by the spring fence. The culprit smells of petrol.

habits.label: Mittens on a string
habits.habit: Always cold and wears mittens on a string, like a nursery child
clues: A woollen mitten with its string snapped hangs on the spring fence. The culprit wears mittens on a string.
The frost on the gallery rail has smudged prints with no fingers, as if someone held the rail in mittens. The culprit wears mittens on a string.

habits.label: Pager on the belt
habits.habit: The pager on their belt beeps at the worst possible moment
clues: At 01:45 the novice heard a pager beep behind the spring fence. The culprit carries a pager.
A plastic pager clip lies on the bench under the awning by the spring. The culprit carries a pager.

strong: Himeno was strangled for a long time and fought back: the snow around is churned up. Only a very strong person could hold down a hunter with her training. The culprit is physically strong.
The spring gate was jammed from inside with an iron crowbar driven into the frozen ground with bare hands. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The gallery floor is an old "nightingale floor": the boards sing at every step so nobody can sneak up. The abbot was awake in the next cell and didn't hear a sound. The culprit moves silently.
Two people stayed up in the guest hall until morning, and neither noticed anyone leave the table and come back. The culprit moves silently.
tools: The bamboo gate to the spring squeals loud enough for the whole temple to hear, yet tonight it opened silently: the hinges were taken off, oiled and put back. The culprit is good with their hands.
A huge sackcloth glove stuffed with cotton wool was found under the decking by the spring. That's what left the "ghost hand" marks on her neck. The culprit is good with their hands.
medic: Himeno's flask smells bitter: a drug that weakens the hands and muddles the mind was mixed into her sake. The culprit knows medicine.
Himeno was dragged out of the hot water onto the snow to throw off the time of death: in the frost a body cools far faster. The culprit knows medicine.
keys: At night the spring gate is padlocked, and the abbot carries the key on his belt. The padlock wasn't knocked off: it was unlocked and left hanging. The culprit had a key.
The generator shed is always locked. In the morning the padlock was snapped shut, but its shackle was wet with melted snow. The culprit had a key.
safe: In the evening Himeno had already summoned the Ghost against the Avalanche Devil, and it won't come a second time before dawn. Someone knew she was defenceless tonight. The culprit understands devil contracts.

A sheet with the terms of her contract copied out was found in the pocket of Himeno's yukata. Papers like that are kept classified in the division, and you need to know how to read them. The culprit understands devil contracts.
sched: Himeno only went to the spring after one in the morning when everyone was asleep: she didn't want anyone to see her without her eyepatch. Only insiders knew. The culprit knows the routine here.
At 01:30 the monks get up for night sutra reading, and the drum booms through the whole temple. Under that din nobody heard the noise by the spring. The culprit knows the routine here.
tech: The phone in the temple office isn't silent because of the blizzard: the wire was disconnected in the junction box and the lid closed. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The squad's radio was retuned to a different frequency, and Tokyo heard no calls all night. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
cash: Someone paid the monks three times the rate to get the cell right by the spring gate. The culprit has money.
The village tractor driver was paid generously in cash in advance to clear the road by six in the morning. The culprit has money.
passages: An old stone drain runs under the gallery from the spring to the pond. You can crawl through it without setting foot on the snow. The culprit knows the temple like the back of their hand.
Snow has been swept off the gallery roof in a narrow strip right up to the spring fence: someone came to Himeno over the top. The culprit knows the temple like the back of their hand.
